tasks.label: db:create:from-env
tasks.command: $cfg=@{}; Get-Content 'database/.env.local.postgres' | ForEach-Object { $l=$_.Trim(); if(-not $l -or $l.StartsWith('#')){ return }; $i=$l.IndexOf('='); if($i -lt 1){ return }; $cfg[$l.Substring(0,$i).Trim()]=$l.Substring($i+1).Trim() }; $env:PGPASSWORD=$cfg['PGPASSWORD']; & 'C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\18\bin\createdb.exe' -h $cfg['PGHOST'] -p $cfg['PGPORT'] -U $cfg['PGUSER'] $cfg['PGDATABASE']

tasks.label: api:health-login:verify
tasks.command: $health = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:8787/health' -Method Get; Write-Output ('health_ok=' + $health.ok); $body = @{ email = 'test@mit.co'; password = 'testpass' } | ConvertTo-Json; try { $login = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:8787/auth/login' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body; Write-Output ('login_ok=true'); Write-Output ('role=' + $login.role); Write-Output ('sessionId=' + $login.sessionId) } catch { Write-Output ('login_ok=false'); if ($_.ErrorDetails.Message) { Write-Output $_.ErrorDetails.Message } else { Write-Output $_.Exception.Message } }

tasks.label: api:health-login:final
tasks.command: $health = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:8787/health' -Method Get; Write-Output ('health_ok=' + $health.ok); $body = @{ email = 'test@mit.co'; password = 'testpass' } | ConvertTo-Json; try { $login = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:8787/auth/login' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body; Write-Output ('login_ok=true'); Write-Output ('role=' + $login.role); Write-Output ('sessionId=' + $login.sessionId) } catch { Write-Output ('login_ok=false'); if ($_.ErrorDetails.Message) { Write-Output $_.ErrorDetails.Message } else { Write-Output $_.Exception.Message } }

tasks.label: android:discover:avd
tasks.command: $emulator = Get-Command emulator -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($emulator) { & $emulator.Source -list-avds } elseif (Test-Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Android\Sdk\emulator\emulator.exe") { & "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Android\Sdk\emulator\emulator.exe" -list-avds } else { Write-Output 'NO_EMULATOR_BIN' }; adb devices

tasks.label: android:sdk:paths
tasks.command: Write-Output "ANDROID_HOME=$env:ANDROID_HOME"; Write-Output "ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"; Write-Output "LOCALAPPDATA=$env:LOCALAPPDATA"; if (Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.android\avd") { Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\.android\avd" -Name } else { Write-Output 'NO_AVD_DIR' }; if (Test-Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Android\Sdk\emulator\emulator.exe") { Write-Output 'EMU_OK'; & "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Android\Sdk\emulator\emulator.exe" -list-avds } else { Write-Output 'EMU_MISSING' }; if (Test-Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe") { Write-Output 'ADB_OK' } else { Write-Output 'ADB_MISSING' }

tasks.label: android:check:cmdline-tools
tasks.command: $sdkRoot = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Android\Sdk"; $avdManager = Join-Path $sdkRoot 'cmdline-tools\latest\bin\avdmanager.bat'; $sdkManager = Join-Path $sdkRoot 'cmdline-tools\latest\bin\sdkmanager.bat'; Write-Output "AVDMANAGER_EXISTS=$([bool](Test-Path $avdManager))"; Write-Output "SDKMANAGER_EXISTS=$([bool](Test-Path $sdkManager))"; if (Test-Path $avdManager) { & $avdManager list avd }

tasks.label: android:check:cmdline-tools:retry
tasks.command: $sdkRoot = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\Sdk'; $avdManager = Join-Path $sdkRoot 'cmdline-tools\latest\bin\avdmanager.bat'; $sdkManager = Join-Path $sdkRoot 'cmdline-tools\latest\bin\sdkmanager.bat'; Write-Output ('AVDMANAGER_EXISTS=' + (Test-Path $avdManager)); Write-Output ('SDKMANAGER_EXISTS=' + (Test-Path $sdkManager)); if (Test-Path $avdManager) { & $avdManager list avd }
